correctness.rationale: By bipartite edge-coloring, 3-colorability is exactly both row and column degrees <=3. Maximality forces the low-row x low-column block full. Deficit arithmetic exhausts the four low-set size cases and isolates the n=m and n=m+1 exceptional families. Counting degree margins establishes the formulas. Direct enumeration of 1,413,632 subsets over six cases and independent graph coloring on two cases agree.

value.rationale: The known well-k-partite criterion motivates asking for actual labeled maximal cardinality distributions. This exact theorem distinguishes up to three different cardinalities and their multiplicities and explains the sharp square/near-square/rectangular transition. Mixed-margin low-defect enumeration is genuinely additional to both the qualitative 2022 result and known regular-matrix sequence.
